successors.name: Ashanti Empire
successors.text: Bonoman, defeated in 1723 by Opoku Ware I; the royal line re-established at Takyiman (Techiman) by 1740 paid annual tribute to Asante

ledger.x: c. 1100: Bono Manso is the capital of the Bono state. Infobox 'Established: 11th-13th century'; 'Bono Manso was settled by the 13th century' and 'was the capital of the Bono state from the 11th century' (Bono Manso page: founded c. 1000 CE). The page treats a founding date of 1295 as unsupported.
second half of the 15th century: Bonoman expands over the Brong country.
1723: Bono Manso is destroyed and Bonoman passes to Asante.

wars.name: Asante conquest of Bono
wars.outcome: Asante victory: Bono defeated in 1723 and Bono Manso destroyed by Opoku Ware I; the Bono royal line later re-established at Techiman as an Asante tributary.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the extent is the Brong country, drawn from the modern region as a stand-in.
